text:
Dana Kim: Quick sync after the postmortem — the recurring pool-exhaustion pattern needs a short, testable playbook change + a tiny remediation tracker dashboard. I want owners and firm checkpoints. Propose 10 days for playbook edits, 21 days for automation.

Omar Singh: I can take the playbook checklist. My plan: compress triage into a 5-step card, include exact commands, and a tiny decision matrix (when to shed traffic, when to restart, when to escalate).

Helena Park: Important: add an explicit ‘safety gate’ before restarts so people don't loop restarts. Suggest: require confirmation that waiting_clients decreased after config changes and a manual ack from DB oncall if waiting_clients > 300.

Marcus Lowe: I'll build the remediation tracker (small Grafana panel + GitHub-linked checklist). It should show: open postmortem actions, owner, status, and a recurrence score (count in 30d). ETA: first draft in 2 weeks.

DevOpsBot: NOTE: Related alerts in last 60d = 4. Auto-ticket created: INF-10822. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INF-10822

Dana Kim: Action items I want created now:
- Playbook 1-pager (owner: Omar) — due 2026-04-07
- Safety-gate + anti-loop rules (owner: Helena) — due 2026-04-05
- Remediation tracker prototype (owner: Marcus) — due 2026-04-20
- Tabletop test (owner: Dana) — schedule by 2026-04-09, run 2026-04-14
Will create GH issues and tag postmortem-INF-10822.

Omar Singh: Copyable checklist snippet for playbook (to include in PR):
```
# quick triage (copy-paste)
ssh infra@db-primary-1 'systemctl is-active pgbouncer'
pgbouncer-admin show clients | awk '{print $4}' | sort | uniq -c
curl -s "http://prometheus/api/v1/query?query=sum(rate(pgbouncer_connection_failures_total[5m]))"
# if waiting_clients > 250 for 5m => run traffic-shed plan
```

Helena Park: Safety-gate pseudo rules: 1) Max 1 restart per 10m per host. 2) Before restart, check `pgbouncer.kv_cache_hit_ratio > 0.6` else escalate. 3) If restart performed, monitor waiting_clients for 3m; if no improvement, rollback and page DB oncall.

Marcus Lowe: Remediation tracker details: it will query issues labeled postmortem-INF-10822 and surface due dates. Also adds a recurrence badge for signals with >=2 occurrences in 30d. Will open PR with README for operators.

Dana Kim: Good. I'll make the GH issues, assign owners, and put a weekly check-in on Fridays in #incidents. If someone needs to shift a date, post here with new ETA and reason. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
